problem_statement:
Definition list and ruby plugins broken after recent changes

#### Description

The definition list and ruby plugins are not working correctly. When trying to parse markdown with definition lists or ruby annotations, the output is malformed or completely broken.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import mistune
from mistune.plugins import def_list, ruby

# Test definition list
md = mistune.create_markdown(plugins=['def_list'])
def_list_text = """Apple
:   Pomaceous fruit of plants of the genus Malus in 
    the family Rosaceae.

Orange
:   The fruit of an evergreen tree of the genus Citrus."""

result = md(def_list_text)
print("Definition list result:")
print(result)

# Test ruby annotations
md_ruby = mistune.create_markdown(plugins=['ruby'])
ruby_text = "This is {ruby base}(ruby text) annotation."

result_ruby = md_ruby(ruby_text)
print("\nRuby result:")
print(result_ruby)
```

The definition lists are not being rendered as proper `<dl>` elements and ruby annotations are producing incorrect HTML structure. The ruby text and base text appear to be swapped in the output.

#### Expected Behavior

Definition lists should render as proper HTML definition lists with `<dl>`, `<dt>`, and `<dd>` tags. Ruby annotations should render with the base text in `<rb>` tags and the annotation text in `<rt>` tags.

#### Actual Behavior

The plugins produce malformed HTML or fail to parse the markdown syntax correctly.
